# Smarter Justice

Smarter Justice is a legal and tax starting-help network, public professional directory, and private portfolio coordinator for focused portals. It is not a law firm, tax firm, accounting firm, insurer, court, or government website and does not guarantee outcomes.

Version 1.7.41 refines attorney and firm signup, profile management, and recurring membership checkout while preserving fail-closed launch controls and exact legal-network governance. Directory totals remain 281 public records and 278 strict qualifying profiles because no unverified profile padding was added. Paid public services, professional enrollment, inquiry delivery, booking, reviews, confidential uploads, routing, filing, automatic cross-repository writes, centralized public-user matter storage, live Neutral Boardroom integration, and sensitive-storage services remain closed.

Public users may describe a situation or a notice without including sensitive details and receive a starting-point suggestion that is not saved as an account or saved case. Confidential production uploads remain unavailable.

Attorneys, tax professionals, law firms, and accounting firms may create a central professional account, locate or request control of profiles, manage approved information, record practice and participation preferences, and prepare a membership application. Profile control, identity, credentials, membership, availability, sponsorship, and access to optional professional opportunities remain separate. Membership does not guarantee clients, matters, rankings, revenue, or outcomes.

Justice Truck is the original and continuing community-access, vehicle, street, kiosk, event, and field-outreach brand. Smarter Justice is the broader network of focused portals, shared technology, professional profiles, and online starting tools. Specialty portals remain primary for their subjects.

The private Control Center tracks portals, packages, versions, tests, roadmaps, blockers, accounts, claims, memberships, field programs, public-service initiatives, and readiness evidence. Sensitive traffic, payments, booking, reviews, unrestricted matching, and broad cross-portal sharing remain closed until separately approved and verified.

Device-only Communication & Evidence Log: https://smarterjustice.com/communication-evidence-log.html (records user-entered communications, observations, preservation status, and follow-up; no call recording, file collection, evidence verification, deadline calculation, reminder, save, upload, AI, lead, or routing)
Device-only Date & Deadline Organizer: https://smarterjustice.com/date-deadline-organizer.html (records user-entered dates; no legal deadline calculation, reminder, save, upload, AI, lead, or routing)
